data.body:
Removed the dangling caused_by link ceae9de7-8992-47c2-855c-60825331adc3 (target_id '6ed2') with 'rebar unlink frank-rocky-rat 6ed2 caused_by' from the merged build of lionly-squarish-xantus (Gerrit 3262, commit 24b2a71926e6eba2af5bacc82fe2c267a71905b6). No force or break-glass path was used. The remaining links, discovered_from -> 6ed2-24e5-6985-4faa and relates_to -> c306-6ba1-556e-4f8b, are unchanged.

No replacement caused_by was written, on purpose:
- The evidence in the earlier comment points at the epic 6ed2-24e5-6985-4faa (traitorous-official-sunbittern).
- But this was a plan defect: the epic's AC1 glob measured the wrong set. No commit introduced it, so there is no culprit change to name.
- caused_by should name the change that introduced a defect, not credit an epic. The epic relationship is already recorded by the existing discovered_from link.
